display_name: LoRa W24 弱复数差异传递与训练预算对照（Full）
description: Compare matched 48000-step packet U-Nets with a private complex weak-probe gain ablation. Source-only 24000-step snapshots are evaluated after both fits finish.
authorization: Active LoRa DURA W24 performance goal and user instruction to launch when memory permits.

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI pinned W24 archives for fit/inference; Windows phase1-cu128 for independent scoring.
code.cwd: Original 7615e8e4 archived training release for fitting; archived W24 inference release for prediction.

data.representation: At fit 8192 complex points; at W24 readout 8 chirps × I/Q × (384 center + 48 native edge).
data.physical_ids_ref: Ordered source V physical IDs and archived blind RX order, 2000 target packets per receiver
data.label_map_ref: Original W24 frozen class mapping; target labels scorer only
data.leo_config_ref: Registered native Full clean and six practical views.

permissions.claim_scope: TX-blind source U IQ and paired generic perturbations only until freeze. Source V and, if qualified, Full-only target; no Residual execution.

checkpoint.initialization: Same random seed 2026112991, 308676 parameters per arm. No imported model or optimizer during fitting.

sources.role: Archived code and frozen external comparator only
Previously frozen source comparator only in independent evaluation. No fitting or freezing access.
Unchanged original-loss 24,000-step U-Net for frozen evaluation comparison only, no fitting access

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Registered source U and physical IDs for scratch fitting. All comparison checkpoints and frozen E104 opened only for post-freeze comparison.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: No checkpoint used in fit. Historical DURA, U-Net and W24 checkpoint rows are independent frozen source comparisons.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Freeze the 48000 step for qualification and formal delivery only. The two 24000 steps are fixed halfway-of-same-schedule diagnostics, evaluated only after both complete fits. Formal eligible iff primary defeats fixed source comparisons under the preregistered same-row rule.

execution.gpu_policy: Prefer GPU 0 and 3, eligible fallback 2 and 5; 12 GiB live free memory, one experiment worker per GPU, existing occupancy checked.
execution.stop_rule: Stop on a systemic technical/protocol failure, incompatible source or frozen comparator, collision, or prediction/scoring failure. Preserve all artifacts. Source scores gate only target eligibility via preregistered paired rules.

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Independent source scorer; E:/type10-7/local_envs/phase1-cu128/Scripts/python.exe -m experiments.pamf_lora_main.w24_third_prior collect-score --weak-transfer after the three formal Full shards freeze.

rows.seed_notes: Seed 2026112991 fixes source row ordering and generic perturbations. Source V panel 2026112559. Test waveform stream inherits 2026112207; evaluation identifies W24 E104 model seed. Phase1 has no support or K.

rows.budget_ref: 48000 scratch updates of all parameters, batch 16, AdamW, held steps 2000, 6000, 12000, 18000, 24000, 36000, 42000, final 48000.

rows.method: Matched U-Net plus private complex gain error

rows.optimizer: AdamW, cosine 2e-4 to 2e-5, weight decay 1e-4, clip 1.

notes: Both arms use matched packet U-Net, source-derived weak differences and three corresponding source views, same scratch seed, records, AdamW schedule, half-readout objective and clean identity.

The sole candidate loss addition is 0.35 times complex gain projection error on private zero-sum chirp components. Per chirp divide by band mean reference power plus 0.0001. Measured detail bands use 0 < abs(f) <= 1/32 and 1/32 < abs(f) <= 1/8 at the W24 center clock.

Save checkpoint after update 24000 and before 24001, without classifier selection. Freeze 48000 before any source W24 evaluation. Midpoint uses actual .5 amplitude only. Endpoint uses actual .5 and doubled stress.

The six-scene gate uses final candidate and final control only plus fixed direct, DURA pairs and 24000 original U-Net. Neither within-fit snapshots nor published target results affect training, model selection or replay.
